impact.why_not_5: Genuinely new human-calibrated enforcement testbed, but all evidence comes from one provider, and the policy takeaway stays descriptive: nothing shown reaches the silent coordination it identifies.
impact.one_change_for_5: Run a second, non-Claude provider through the four core regimes so the human-versus-agent gap is shown to be general, not a Claude family trait.
impact.feasibility_why: Depends on uncertain GPU credits or a local open model; JSON compliance and the positive control may fail, though four regimes fit in a day.

execution.why_not_5: Unusually good controls and pre-registration, but only four pool sessions per regime, ten and four cartels under leniency and reward, and mechanisms rest on interpretation, not recorded reasons.
execution.one_change_for_5: Double the core regimes to eight pools and classify the recorded reasons with a hand-validated frozen judge, turning the mechanism claims into measured evidence.
execution.feasibility_why: About 4 to 6 USD and under ten hours; runs parallelise, and hand-checking 40 judge labels is bounded manual work.

presentation.why_not_5: Running text is saturated with numbers, Table 3 columns wrap into fragments, Figure 1 labels overlap, and the printed title states findings instead of the contribution.
presentation.one_change_for_5: Open each results paragraph with one plain finding, move numbers into slimmer tables, fix Table 3 and Figure 1, and print the testbed title.
presentation.feasibility_why: Pure editing and re-rendering, no new runs; four to five hours.

K1.risk_note: Point estimates may shift and force rewriting numbers across text, tables and figure; Result 3 may still miss.

K2.risk_note: Sonnet without channel may price like prohibited arms, reframing silent coordination as plain no-channel behaviour; still informative.

K3.risk_note: New regime without human baseline; a told price screen trivially pushes prices to Nash, and scope eats page budget.

K4.risk_note: Stated reasons may be unfaithful; judge agreement with hand labels may be weak, needing careful caveats.

K5.risk_note: Credits uncertain; open model may fail JSON or positive control, burning a day for nothing reportable.

K6.risk_note: Cutting numbers from text may hide denominators; keep every number reachable in tables.

package.why: About 18 hours and 22 USD, leaving buffer for rewriting and checks. K3 is a second paper with no human baseline; K5 hinges on uncertain credits and could consume a full day.

five_realistic.why: Impact and execution are close: novel framing, strong validation; one family and thin cartel counts block a 5. Presentation can reach a clean 4, but the inherent number density keeps it from being a model.

stable_optimum: 4/4/4: more pools, a Sonnet no-channel baseline and analysed reasons firm up execution, the edit lifts presentation, but impact stays capped by a single provider.
missing_candidate: A prompt-robustness arm: rerun the four Haiku core regimes with an independently paraphrased instruction set (about 3 USD) and report whether the scorecard and key gaps survive wording changes.
